pin.title: Near Peter Mokaba Stadium, Polokwane (approx.): man, 29, assaulted by a group, dies in hospital, 4 Oct
pin.location_note: Near the stadium, in the early hours after a show at the Peter Mokaba rugby field, Polokwane (police, via Review Online). No street or exact spot given. The pin is the Peter Mokaba Stadium map point, inside the Polokwane police precinct; approximate, within about 1.5 km. It is not the scene.
